details:
While I already would love more options for available worlds to be favorited, since some people, like myself categorize their saved worlds.

Like, as an example;

Entertainment (games,music or video player worlds)

Roleplay (for any worlds that would make a good roleplay stage)

Calming (for just worlds that have a relaxing vibe)

Avatars (to save avatar worlds I wanna keep track of, ect.)

But because there really are millions of worlds out there, it's hard to keep track and honestly, some I just don't have the time to look at but wanna check out. So I end up shoving them into a saved spot that should be taken by something else. This makes lists fill up too fast out of the desire to look at them later but being so limited on room.

If instead of being forced to save them, for worlds we want to look into later it would be nice to simply have a designated area called, 'Bookmarked Worlds', or something of the like. So that we can click on the world and instead of clicking the star, we put it in our bookmarks.

This area would be where we can bookmark it to view at another time.

I know it may seem silly but when there are as many world as there are and we already are limited on how many worlds we can favorite... and then also only having four categories... it's really hard and I end up frustrated, having to remove a lot of useful worlds I like just so I can make room for a world I'm not even sure I'll like.
title: Look At Later List
